orthophoto.title: IPR Praha, Ortofotomapa Prahy – poslední snímkování (10 cm), 8. 6. 2024, a infračervená ortofotomapa

method: Surveyed DTM track axes (OSM tracks where none) within 30 m of the route, without bridge decks, sampled every 2.0 m; a 4.0 x 2.4 m window at 0.2 m; samples under measured tree crowns (IPR greenery, DSM detection) or with a canopy-like index are unknown. grass: NIR/red index above the paved reference of its 512 m block by 0.075 (0.045 when warm); ballast: sleeper pitch power > 0.55 with warm, textured stones; otherwise paved. Majority of 7 neighbours along each track; shadow and canopy filled from neighbours; grass runs under 44 m and ballast runs under 20 m revert to paved.
